title: Historical origin is a conjunctive claim, not a strongest-match claim
sources_inspected: repository indexed search for M-004, M-005, and M-006

observed: M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unresolved in the canonical queue.
The prior continuity slice established that search silence and downstream occurrence are leads rather than origin evidence.
Current indexed repository search did not return an exact assignment object for M-004, M-005, or M-006.
The specialist registry contains no continuity-specific roles and the present slice reveals no durable capability gap requiring a registry mutation.
inferred: Selecting the strongest-looking candidate without complete agreement across assignment, namespace, owner, semantic role, temporal precedence, immutable locator, and conflict checks would reconstruct unverified history.
Coverage completeness and candidate identity must be represented separately so a valid-looking object cannot conceal incomplete search coverage.
proposed: Permit verified_origin only when the exact assignment is present, exhaustive coverage flags are true, known blind spots are empty, and every agreement dimension is true.
Retain candidate or quarantined state whenever any mandatory dimension is false, unknown, ambiguous, or untested.
superseded: Promoting the earliest returned result as origin.
Promoting the semantically closest result as origin.
Treating immutable blob identity alone as proof of namespace, ownership, temporal precedence, or historical authority.
Collapsing incomplete coverage and negative findings into an absence claim.
unresolved: The immutable originating assignment objects for M-004, M-005, and M-006.
An exhaustive authenticated ref, reachable-commit, historical-path, and deleted-path traversal.
The privacy-safe originating decision log, language lexicon, project document, or chat-history locator for each identifier.

durable_rule.rule: Historical origin is verified only by conjunction. No single match, locator, timestamp, search result, or semantic resemblance may substitute for complete assignment evidence, complete coverage, multidimensional agreement, and absence of a conflicting accepted origin.

contradictions_resolved.apparent_contradiction: A candidate can have exact bytes and still not be the authoritative origin.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Blob identity proves content identity only; historical authority additionally requires repository, commit, path, explicit assignment, namespace, owner, semantic role, temporal precedence, and conflict agreement.

contradictions_resolved.apparent_contradiction: No indexed result appears, yet absence cannot be declared.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Indexed search coverage is not exhaustive branch and history coverage; the correct state remains unresolved rather than absent.

included: search outcomes without private source text
excluded: personal, medical, financial, household, or relationship material

falsification_route: Provide an immutable exact-assignment object that satisfies the contract and predates every conflicting candidate.
Demonstrate exhaustive ref and history coverage with retained raw traversal output.
Show that any required agreement dimension can be safely omitted without permitting a false origin promotion.
next_action: Implement and run a validator against synthetic positive and negative candidates, then execute authenticated exhaustive repository traversal and evaluate every M-004, M-005, and M-006 candidate without promoting incomplete evidence.
